svg.title: Differential Geometry Foundations
svg.desc: Five-panel mathematical plate linking manifold structure, metric, geodesics, curvature and viability geometry for resilient systems.
svg.metadata: Mathematical foundations are separated from engineering interpretation and empirical validation.
svg.text: Intrinsic geometry for state spaces, trajectories and viability
Geometry is an engineering claim only after the state space, metric and validity domain are formally justified.
